verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a registry, leaderboard, and CLI installer that copies or symlinks SKILL.md packages into other agents' directories. It is not itself an agent that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows it connecting to MCP servers or managing MCP server configs. The spec's experimental `allowed-tools` field only declares tools for the host agent, so it does not make this axis applicable.
